agent_responses:
Here are the reviewers on this **Nearpow Samsung Galaxy S6 tempered glass screen protector** listing who mention good fingerprint resistance (out of 12 total reviews across both pages):

1. **Rachel** (⭐ 100%) — *"It is super clear and fingerprint resistant. ... Bubbles went away around the small hairs..."*
2. **T. Gannon** (⭐ 100%) — *"it does seem to resist fingerprints and stay cleaner. This is noticeable especially for swipe entries as my finger glides much more easily on the screen."*

One borderline mention worth flagging:

3. **Open Source Prof** (⭐ 80%) — doesn't use the phrase "fingerprint resistant," but notes the oleophobic feel: *"your finger just glides over the screen – nice!"*

No reviewers on page 2 added anything about fingerprint resistance. I reviewed all pages of the reviews section.
